newsitem.title: USA: ValuJet says it has had no word from DOT.
newsitem.headline: ValuJet says it has had no word from DOT.

text.p: ValuJet Inc said on Thursday that it had received no word from the U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) about when to expect a final ruling on its bid to return to the skies.
The Atlanta Journal-Constitution reported that the DOT could issue a final ruling on ValuJet Inc's resumption of flight service by the end of this week.
The newspaper quoted an aide to U.S. Rep. Mac Collins, a Georgia Republican, as saying this week was "looking good" for a final ruling from the federal government.
